card.name: The 'ar' in laminar flow hood
card.fires_on: The final piece 'ar' of the word 'laminar' in the phrase 'laminar flow hood'. It appears in instructions to prepare or use a product in a suitable aseptic work area.

modes.label: Laminar flow hood
modes.description: The ending of 'laminar' when the text names a laminar flow hood as the work area for preparing a product.
modes.example: It should only be prepared in an aseptic work area, such as a lamin<<ar>> flow hood.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about clean, sterile preparation settings, though the promoted tokens are mostly unrelated Chinese words.
card.plain: It lights up on the end of 'laminar' when a label says to prepare the drug in a laminar flow hood.
